title: 수도방위사령부령 / queue:ADDENDUM:25751:20141119:00005:part:1/1
full_text:
ADDENDA (Organization of the Ministry of the Interior and Its Affiliated Agencies) <No. 25751, November 19, 2014>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date) This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation: Provided, That where provisions of Presidential Decrees amended under Article 5 of these Addenda amend Presidential Decrees that have been promulgated but have not yet entered into force before this Decree enters into force, each such amended provision shall enter into force on the enforcement date of the corresponding Presidential Decree.

Articles 2 through 4 Omitted.

Article 5 (Amendment of Other Statutes and Regulations) (1) through (93) Omitted.

(94) The Decree on the Capital Defense Command is partially amended as follows:

In the latter part of Article 7, "Minister of Security and Public Administration" shall be replaced with "Minister of the Interior".

(95) through (418) Omitted.
